games.name: Pokémon Memory
games.blurb: Match the type tiles.
games.instructions: Flip two tiles. Matching types stay up. Decoy tiles cost extra moves. You have a limited number of moves.
games.scoringRules: 1 point per pair matched.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Pokémon Catching Challenge
games.blurb: Tag the Pokémon as they run past.
games.instructions: Pokémon cross the field. Tag them before they leave. Rarer Pokémon move faster and score more. You have limited throws and time.
games.scoringRules: 1–3 points per Pokémon tagged.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Rhythm Challenge
games.blurb: Hit the notes in time.
games.instructions: Notes fall down four lanes. Press the lane as a note reaches the bottom row. Build a combo for bonus points.
games.scoringRules: 2 points for a perfect hit, 1 for early, +1 per 5 combo.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Foraging and Berry Picking
games.blurb: Pick the best berries before the basket is full.
games.instructions: Berries come one at a time. Take or skip. Your basket holds only a few. Some berries are rotten.
games.scoringRules: Total value of the berries in the basket, minus rotten ones.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Pokémon Knowledge Quiz
games.blurb: Questions from the real Pokédex.
games.instructions: Answer questions about types, evolutions, abilities and stats. All questions use the game's own data.
games.scoringRules: 1 point per right answer.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Fossil Excavation
games.blurb: Dig up treasures with a worn tool.
games.instructions: Dig tiles; a number shows treasures next to it. Your tool wears out with each dig.
games.scoringRules: Value of the treasures found.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Fishing Challenge
games.blurb: Reel in fish without snapping the line.
games.instructions: Keep the line tension in the green zone while the fish tires. Reel to pull, ease to relax.
games.scoringRules: Rarity points of the fish you land.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Battle Puzzle
games.blurb: Win with a fixed team and limited moves.
games.instructions: Defeat each foe in the turns you have. Moves have limited uses. Type matchups matter.
games.scoringRules: 3 points for a quick win, 2 for a win, per puzzle.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Type-Match Puzzle
games.blurb: Match type tiles to reach the target.
games.instructions: Pick two tiles. Same type scores 2. If the second is super effective against the first it scores 1.
games.scoringRules: Points from matched tiles.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Pokémon Tracking
games.blurb: Follow the clues to the hidden Pokémon.
games.instructions: Search a spot. Clues tell you warm or cold. Find the Pokémon in as few searches as you can.
games.scoringRules: Searches left when you find it, per round.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Berry-Growing Challenge
games.blurb: Water each patch just right.
games.instructions: Spread your water over the patches. Each wants a different amount. Too much or too little lowers the harvest.
games.scoringRules: Harvest quality of each patch.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Trainer's Trial
games.blurb: Pick the best Pokémon for each situation.
games.instructions: A foe appears. Choose the team member whose attack hits hardest.
games.scoringRules: 1 point per best pick.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Treasure Hunt
games.blurb: Follow hints, choose your risks.
games.instructions: At each fork choose the safe path or the risky one. Hints are usually right.
games.scoringRules: Safe path 1 point; risky path 3 points if it pays off.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Reaction Challenge
games.blurb: Press when the light turns green.
games.instructions: Wait for the green light, then press at once. Do not press on red. The window is wide on Easy and in slow mode.
games.scoringRules: 1 point per fast press; early presses cost a point.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Maze Runner
games.blurb: Find the door in the fog.
games.instructions: Walk tile by tile through the fog. Pits cost 3 steps. Reach the door before you run out of steps.
games.scoringRules: Steps left when you reach the door (plus the shortest path).
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Lock Picking
games.blurb: Tap when the pick lines up.
games.instructions: The pick sweeps back and forth. Tap PICK while it sits on the filled zone. Each miss costs a try.
games.scoringRules: 1 point per pin opened.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Sky Race
games.blurb: Fly through the rings.
games.instructions: Tap a lane to fly there. Rings score, rocks cost HP. The race ends at the finish or at 0 HP.
games.scoringRules: 1 point per ring.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Safari Zone
games.blurb: Few steps, few balls.
games.instructions: Throw bait to calm a Pokémon, then throw a Safari Ball. Every action costs a step. Catch the goal number before the steps or balls run out.
games.scoringRules: 1 point per catch (up to the goal).
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Sliding Tiles
games.blurb: Put the tiles in order.
games.instructions: Slide tiles next to the gap until 1 to 8 are in order. You have a limited number of moves.
games.scoringRules: 1 point per tile in its place.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Berry Blending
games.blurb: Blend Poffins; the main flavour raises a contest condition.
games.instructions: Add berries to match the wanted flavours. Too much counts against you as much as too little.
games.scoringRules: Wanted flavour points minus your overshoot and shortfall.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Camp Cooking
games.blurb: Cook curry and sandwiches; the party heals.
games.instructions: Add ingredients so the pot matches the order. Serve when it looks right.
games.scoringRules: Order points minus your overshoot and shortfall.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Battle Factory
games.blurb: Rent a team and win rounds.
games.instructions: Rent three Pokémon, then win rounds against rental teams. Between rounds you may swap a rental. Fights are played out by the battle engine.
games.scoringRules: 1 point per round won.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: One try per stop; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Battle Palace
games.blurb: Set the lineup; they fight on their own.
games.instructions: Pick the lineup order from five Pokémon. In the Palace your Pokémon choose their own moves. Win rounds in a row.
games.scoringRules: 1 point per round won.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: One try per stop; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Battle Arcade
games.blurb: Spin the wheel, then fight.
games.instructions: A wheel sets a modifier for the next fight (levels up or down). You may spin again a few times. Fight, and win rounds.
games.scoringRules: 1 point per round won.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: One try per stop; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Battle Pyramid
games.blurb: Climb dark floors.
games.instructions: Feel through a dark floor to the stairs. Hidden trainers fight you when you step on them: a win scores extra, a loss ends the climb.
games.scoringRules: 2 points per floor, 1 per trainer beaten.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: One try per stop; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Pokéathlon Course
games.blurb: Run the obstacle course.
games.instructions: Each obstacle likes one stat. Pick a stat to try it (1 energy). Your five stats are random but fair. Rest twice to recover.
games.scoringRules: 1 point per obstacle cleared.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Bug Contest
games.blurb: Bring the judges your best bug.
games.instructions: Search spots for bugs. Keep one in your cage or release it. The judges score size, rarity and health of the best.
games.scoringRules: Points of the best bug in the cage (25 is perfect).
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Puzzle Slots
games.blurb: A slot machine with no luck.
games.instructions: Turn the reels so each row shows one symbol. You have just enough turns.
games.scoringRules: 3 per matched row, 1 per pair, 12 at most.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Dance Battle
games.blurb: Copy the rival's routine.
games.instructions: Watch the rival's steps, then repeat them. Each round adds a step. Wrong steps cost a life.
games.scoringRules: 1 point per routine matched.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Pinball Bonus
games.blurb: A bonus round for lucky stops.
games.instructions: Move the flipper under the ball with a tap. Bumpers score. Lose all balls and it ends.
games.scoringRules: Points scored (bumpers 2, saves 1).
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Ranger Styler
games.blurb: Draw capture loops.
games.instructions: Tap the points around the Pokémon in order to close a loop. A wrong tap breaks the line. When it dashes, start again.
games.scoringRules: 1 point per loop closed.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Snap Photo
games.blurb: Dex photo challenge.
games.instructions: Each shot the dex asks for one type. Shoot the right frame; the centre scores most. Limited film.
games.scoringRules: 2 per right shot, 3 for the centre frame.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Pokémon Contest
games.blurb: Show off your lead's conditions.
games.instructions: Each round the judges want one condition. Appeal in it for a big bonus. Your lead's conditions (raised by Poffins from Berry Blending) add to every appeal.
games.scoringRules: Appeal points: 2 + condition + flair, +6 for the judged condition, halved when repeated.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: One entry per stop; each repeat in the same stage pays less.

games.name: Mystery Dungeon
games.blurb: A random floor crawl.
games.instructions: Explore fogged floors. Find the stairs down, pick up loot, and avoid traps. Monsters cost HP but drop loot. You have limited steps.
games.scoringRules: 3 per floor descended plus 1 per loot, up to 5 per floor.
games.failureOutcome: Nothing is lost. You just get no reward.
games.replayRules: Replay any time; each repeat in the same stage pays less.
